releases.name: 10 Second Mixtape
releases.summary:
10 Second Mixtape is a casual game about teaming up to make simple songs with other real people from all over the world. Every track in the game is player-generated; absolutely nothing is prewritten. Don't worry if you're not musically inclined! There are no winners here - it's all about having fun and making silly sounds.

You start in The Venue, your favorite spot to hang out and watch bands! The bands playing are all other players' creations. Your ratings will affect how often that band is booked for shows in everyone else's games. When you start making a song, you'll be given a random instrument and bandmate, and you'll record a 10 second track.

From there, it's time to add more layers! You can pick from demo tapes sent in by other potential band members to add to your track. Finally, it's time to take this show on the road! Watch your band perform the full song live in front of their new fans. Your new 10-second song will go into the infinite playlist of bands that play at The Venue.

releases.name: Pocket Aquarium (Sojourner. Game)
releases.summary: Build your own cozy desktop aquarium. Collect dozens of charming fish, shrimp and snails, decorate with plants, rocks, lighting and substrate, and watch your little creatures swim, forage and grow. Unlock rare, dreamlike fish — or set them free to drift across your desktop.

releases.name: Cards: Tidy Up!
releases.summary: Tidy up a room full of scattered playing cards into neatly completed decks. Sort by theme, suit, and rank in this relaxing first-person tidy-up game. Earn upgrades, discover helpful machines for automation, and find your own satisfying way to clear the table.

releases.name: Lanternborn
releases.summary: ▎ The city of Caldera froze one minute before midnight, and the Hollows came out of the dark. Carry the last light through ever-changing streets, light the lamps, break the Bells and decide how the longest night ends. A dark-fantasy action roguelite with a story.

releases.name: Historical War: The Animation
releases.summary: Historical War: The Animation is a library of classic-war animated reconstructions. Watch famous campaigns from Alexander to the Gulf War on a scrubbable timeline—play, pause, replay. Each film is about five minutes. Napoleon is the dividing line: earlier wars are Ancient, later wars are Modern.

releases.name: E.G.O. Software Suite
releases.summary: Superego Inc. presents E.G.O. Software Suite: personal applications built on state-of-the-art inter-universal technology powered by the SUPERᵁ™ Framework. Browse the Universe Wide Web with our flagship Tempest browser or communicate with people across worlds.

releases.name: Motion De Censure
releases.summary: Brush up on your math skills with the sequel to the best selling math game Number Tap.Practice your math in new and exciting ways!? 2 Fun Game-modes:* Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication & Division* Algebra? Quick & Addictive Gameplay? The better you are, the harder it gets!? Online Leaderboards Race against the clock to complete the sums in this quick paced addictive game. The more questions you get right, the more time you get!The perfect study tool for students trying to improve their grades or practice for exams!Compete in the online leaderboards. Keep your brain sharp with quick thinking.Web: http://numbertap.net Twitter: @CraftyDeano

releases.name: ALL EYES ON ME
releases.summary: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. Thousands of eyes hunt you in this bullet heaven roguelite. Their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play local co-op or online conquests.

releases.name: Can You Beat The AI God?
releases.summary: Can You Beat The AI God? is an action-packed bullet-heaven roguelite. Survive endless swarms of robotic enemies, unlock devastating synergies, and upgrade your abilities. Test your limits and see if you can defeat the ultimate AI God!

releases.name: Whiskers of Yesterday
releases.summary: One warm house, infinite quiet hours. Curl up with other cats in a compact multiplayer retreat packed with 100+ hours of narrated classics, curated indie music, silent cinema, and trivia cards. Small map, rich company.

releases.name: The Halls Remain
releases.summary: - Kids Learn Alphabets is new and fun way of learning alphabets for your kids. It is a must have to help learn alphabets and remember them.- iPod, iPhone and iPad support!- Awesome design, combined with elegant animation and music makes the whole learning experience, great fun for kids.Four levels included in this version:- Learn uppercase letters- Learn lowercase letters- Match the cases game- Missing alphabet gameThe app will definitely help kids improve their alphabet skill. If you have any feedback or suggestion or contribute to the roadmap of this app, please feel free to do so within the app by pressing the 'Send Feedback' button. You will be amazed with our support!Give it a go now!

releases.name: Siegecrawler
releases.summary: Load your crew onto a rumbling siege engine and smash through physics-driven castle walls! Battles run themselves — you steer the tide with spells, three war horns, and perfectly timed ram strikes. Pick a commander, swear an oath, equip skills: every run builds different. 30 stages, then Endless.

releases.name: DemonBlade Pixel: Hyakki Senkou
releases.summary: A 2D bullet-hell action roguelite steeped in yokai fantasy. Collect demon blades with 8 playable fighters, cut through 35 story chapters, challenge Kimon Renrou and boss trials, and play solo or in up to 3-player online co-op.

releases.name: Frontier Tale
releases.summary: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

releases.name: Vizier
releases.summary: To celebrate Valentine's Day, Monster Juice decided to gift couples in love with a game!Have fun with your love, enjoy a passionate soundtrack and try out the first version of Tied.In this fun challenge, every step must be planned: you trail your way with the help of your partner, but be careful, the obstacles are out of control. Walking side by side you will overcome challenges and get to the end.Such a special day deserves to be celebrated in a different way:- An innovative cooperative game- 10 different levels to have fun with someone else- Several challenging obstacles- An amazing and captivating soundtrack

releases.name: TsundereSQL
releases.summary: An SQL course that likes you back.TsundereSQL is an anime visual novel built around a complete SQL course. Write real DuckDB queries, pass hidden tests, and earn story scenes with three instructors who slowly warm up as your skill grows.Every SQL exercise runs against DuckDB. Start with your first SELECT and climb through 224 problems across 14 modules toward production-shaped analytics. Real rows come back, hidden tests decide whether the answer holds, and the story advances when your query holds.What you actually learnThe course contains 224 authored problems across 14 modules. 220 are SQL exercises that run and grade against seeded DuckDB datasets. Four are open-ended analyst-judgment cases with a local fallback, so the curriculum does not depend on live AI.SQL Foundations and Aggregation & GROUP BY, from your first SELECT through trustworthy totals and rates.Joins & Set Operations, including left, right, inner, and anti joins on real tables.Subqueries & CTEs for turning a hard question into readable steps.Window Functions, ranking, QUALIFY, frames, gaps and islands, and sessionization.Product & Growth Analytics, including retention, cohorts, funnels, and experiment-shaped questions.Advanced SQL, recursion, JSON, reshaping, data at scale, and data modeling.Working With Production Data, where dates, NULLs, casts, messy JSON, and inconsistent records matter.Thinking Like a Senior Analyst, the Growth Desk, and the Interview Gauntlet for messy real-world reasoning.If you already write SQL, start at the module that hurts. If you are starting from zero, start at the top and let the difficulty climb with you.The castThree instructors run the course. Tsumugi is demanding, Aimi is patient, and Nora is precise to a fault. Their authored routes and scenes are earned through the work. Romance is optional; the curriculum is not.What this is / what this isn'tWhat it is: a SQL course wrapped in a character-driven story for people who learn better when practice has stakes. Each instructor has a fixed, developer-directed route with its own scenes and ending.What it isn't: it is not a branching-choice simulator where every decision reroutes the plot. The routes are authored and fixed. It is not a reference manual or a multiple-choice quiz: you write the queries, and the game checks them.Runs on DuckDB, in a real editorThe workspace includes a schema browser, query editor, result grid, and a grader that compares results against hidden test data. Passing means your query produces the correct result, not merely that it matches a reference string.Content notesThe game includes optional romance storylines and optional suggestive anime artwork (including swimwear or other revealing, non-nude outfits). Before anything else renders on first launch, a content screen requires an affirmative adult confirmation to continue with suggestive artwork or offers a one-click route that disables it. Suggestive artwork is otherwise on by default after confirmation and can be disabled later in Settings. Romance is enabled by default and can be disabled separately. There is no nudity and no explicit sexual content.

releases.name: Deadzone Cleanup Crew
releases.summary: Scavenge scrap, upgrade your base, hire survivors, and clear zombie-infested zones in Deadzone Cleanup Crew, a click-to-clear apocalypse incremental game with escalating waves, bosses, and big satisfying numbers!

releases.name: Fish Battle Champion
releases.summary: Catch fishes and items from the sea while the sun is up, trade & buy equipment during the evening and attend Fish Autobattle tournament during the night! Survive to the finals and beyond to become the Fish Battle Champion!

releases.name: Disaster Scenario
releases.summary: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear a gauntlet of absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the raucous pitch-and-bet party game — or go solo and 1v1 for a sharper, strategic run. First to the finish wins.

releases.name: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
releases.summary: Turn-based martial arts RPG set in the mid-Ming Dynasty. Play as Cyrus, an Azure Peak disciple, to recruit companion heroes in a corrupt world. Master tactical party-based combat to defeat foes, unravel imperial conspiracies, and choose between personal vengeance and state righteousness.

releases.name: Idle of the Dead
releases.summary: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.
